comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3a9441f and manuals/README.md. The copying is done in CopyPastePresetWidget::step, which waits a few frames after the button goes down, copies the left neighbour's preset to the clipboard, then walks right pasting while consecutive modules share a model. The pulse is a dsp::PulseGenerator triggered with its default length of one millisecond.
